batching: one homogeneous batch per task per superstep; mean combined loss
commit: TypedCommit direct Y paths; P/E replacement, R canonicalized ALU overwrite, W residual
core: one SharedRecurrentCore shared across tasks and rounds
datasets: existing sources adapted to canonical REL/PAIR/ASSIGN/ATTR/VEC; sequential H1 replay table generated in-memory; no source regeneration
loss_combination: sum six task losses divided by six
optimizer: AdamW lr=3e-4; weight_decay=1e-4 trunk only; typed embeddings/heads/decoders/norms/biases weight_decay=0; one step per superstep
reader: one SharedMemoryReader; one read per READ_P/READ_E/ACCUM_W round
resumable: latest.pt stores model, optimizer, step, best metrics, and RNG state; --resume continues at next absolute superstep
sequential_schedule: five supersteps H1 complete 3072 transition table, then one superstep existing H3-H6 composition source; at 12000: 10000 H1 + 2000 composition
workspace_correction: hard-frozen in U0-A; reserved for U0-C
